purpose: Separate offline team-only research baseline; not the three-feature challenger or a deployed model
feature: home minus away win fraction over last 10 accepted prior outcomes; same-day excluded; completion strictly before start minus 60 minutes
missing_data: Refuse missing target label or either 10-game history. Unaccepted historical outcomes are skipped by the existing adapter; this is not guaranteed to be the last 10 actual games.

model.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation; zero variance maps to zero
model.objective: mean binary log loss plus 0.5 times squared slope; intercept unpenalized
model.optimizer: Newton with backtracking; gradient tolerance 1e-10; at most 100 iterations; failure refuses report

baselines.elo: initial 1500; K 20; scale 400; home offset 0; chronological accepted training labels only; frozen after train

evaluation.comparison: same labeled feature-complete games for every model
evaluation.denominator: all regular-season schedule occurrences per split, including refused occurrences
evaluation.model_selection: report all validation and test results without selecting a winner for deployment

live_admission: None; sportsbook comparison and independently verified timing remain absent
